description: This file defines the LoanTransactionProcessingService interface, specifying methods for processing loan transactions, recalculating schedules, and fetching prepayment details within the loan domain of the Fineract project.

classes.name: LoanTransactionProcessingService
classes.description: An interface defining the contract for services that handle processing of loan transactions, recalculations, and related operations within the loan module.

methods.name: canProcessLatestTransactionOnly
methods.description: Determines if only the latest transaction can be processed for a given loan, transaction, and installment.

methods.name: processLatestTransaction
methods.description: Processes the latest transaction on a loan based on a specified strategy and transaction context.

methods.name: reprocessLoanTransactions
methods.description: Reprocesses a list of loan transactions, potentially adjusting the repayment schedule and charges.

methods.name: getTransactionProcessor
methods.description: Retrieves the specific transaction processor based on the provided strategy code.

methods.name: processPostDisbursementTransactions
methods.description: Processes transactions that occur after loan disbursement, if applicable.

methods.name: getRecalculatedSchedule
methods.description: Calculates and returns a new repayment schedule based on provided parameters.

methods.name: fetchPrepaymentDetail
methods.description: Fetches details related to prepayment on a specific date for a loan.
